when: shortening the token-delete line to 終わったら削除します
fact: User said the line was too clipped and hard to follow.
insight: The locked 語数 with 達成できた際は / のため is the readable length.
decision: Keep that sentence. Do not shorten it.

when: locking the three-line and two-bullet Action Guide form
fact: User said ちょうどいい and asked to settle that block.
decision: Action Guide v1.0 is locked.

when: splitting one locked sentence into 手段 目標 条件 理由 措置
fact: User said that labeled split was hard to read and asked to revert.
insight: Structure is for parallel items, not for one packed sentence.
decision: Voice Mark forbids that labeled split.

when: listing parallel items as bullets of the locked 語数
fact: User said the Feature catalog bullets were いい感じ for structure and length.
decision: Use bullets when two or more units are listed. Copy each line from the map.

when: using markdown bold for emphasis in user-facing Japanese
fact: User said bold is hard to see on their screen.
decision: Do not use **bold** in user-facing Japanese.

when: emphasizing with underline and 括弧 instead of bold
fact: User asked to use 下線 and カッコ more.
decision: Voice Mark v1.2: <u>, 「」, （）.

when: using Action Guide on a turn that is not an account click or token
fact: Token-delete bullets were mixed into a framework explanation.
decision: Action Guide is drawn only for click, mint, paste, or revoke.

when: drawing a Feature only when its when matches
fact: User said that draw-and-use explanation was 非常にいい and asked to settle it.
decision: Unmatched units stay closed.

when: asking 定着させるか when a reusable unregistered form appears
fact: User asked for an autonomous settle question in that situation.
decision: Settle Prompt v1.0. Skip it when 定着 is already ordered.

when: looking up units in map.json by layer before opening specs
fact: User asked for hierarchy plus a mapping JSON for cheap reference as the unit count grows.
decision: Unit Map v1.0. One layer level. Copy line from the map.

when: citing progressive disclosure cost versus eager-loading every spec
fact: A 2026 skills-library report measured up to 81.7% fewer tokens with progressive disclosure versus eager load. A second study found one routing level enough and a deeper tree sometimes worse.

when: recording architecture decisions as fact then insight then decision
fact: ADR practice records observed fact, then interpretation, then decision, append-only, without rewriting accepted rows.

when: porting this operating protocol to another system
fact: User asked for a transplantable framework specialized to their purpose and usable in any situation they meet.
insight: Kernel and portable ledger rows move. Purpose Pack is replaced. Purpose-specific Protocol units stay unless that system needs them.
decision: Unit Kernel v1.0, Field Ledger v1.0, Purpose Pack v1.0.

when: mapping contradictions between units in map.json
fact: User said related classifications are already linked and contradictions between features should also be mapped.
insight: related is the compose graph. contradictions is the exclude graph with prefer. forbids is a unit against its own rejected act.
decision: Unit Map v1.1. After a when-match, drop the non-preferred unit and do not open its spec.

when: settling Studio Framework v1.8 and writing the hierarchical text
fact: User asked to settle this constitution and to make the idea understandable as hierarchical text.
decision: Studio Framework v1.8 is settled. Tree: .cursor/framework/HIERARCHY.txt. Do not restyle the constitution without a bump.

when: user approved Studio Framework v1.8
fact: User said Studio Framework v1.8 いいと思います and asked for feature explanations.
decision: Keep v1.8 settled. Explanations: .cursor/framework/FEATURES.txt.

when: implementing Read Ease as low-load Japanese presentation
fact: User asked whether the lowest-load, immediately graspable Japanese tone/structure/style could be implemented.
insight: Plain Japanese research (一文一義, conclusion first, ですます) composes with locked 語数 and 熟語. Ease sits on locked lines. Do not flatten terms.
decision: Read Ease v1.0 on Mark layer with Voice Mark. Studio Framework v1.9.

when: citing signaling meta-analyses for Read Ease cues
fact: Alpizar, Adesope, and Wong 2020 (ETR&D) reported signaling d = 0.38. Schneider, Beege, Nebel, and Rey 2018 reported retention g+ = 0.53 and transfer g+ = 0.33. Mayer coherence median d ≈ 0.86.

when: citing Japanese sentence-length and one-topic results for Read Ease
fact: JMET 25(4) found faster RTs under 50 letters, faster RTs for one-topic sentences, lower accuracy for the first clause when が joins clauses, higher accuracy when the subject sits just before the predicate, and a need for punctuation above about 30 letters.

when: citing Cowan working-memory chunk limit for list length
fact: Cowan 2001 (BBS) estimated a central focus of attention of about 3 to 5 chunks in young adults.

when: locking Read Ease v1.1 sourced rules without shortening locked lines
fact: User asked to integrate peer-reviewed best aspects into Read Ease.
insight: New sentences follow 50-character and 3-4 chunk rules. Locked Action Guide, Registry intro, and unit lines stay. 熟語 stay with a gloss.
decision: Read Ease v1.1. Studio Framework v1.10. Spec: .cursor/rules/read-ease.mdc. Sources: .cursor/framework/READ-EASE-SOURCES.txt.

when: user said Read Ease v1.1 is enough for now including the source mix
fact: User said とりあえず、これで十分だ after being told most sources are general English-language cognitive science, not Japanese-sentence experiments.
decision: Keep Read Ease v1.1 and Studio Framework v1.10. Do not add more sources in this pass. settled: true.

when: making Studio Framework v1.8 downloadable as a zip
fact: User asked to make Studio Framework v1.8 downloadable. Snapshot is commit 685734f.
decision: public/studio-framework-v1.8.zip plus GET /studio-framework-v1.8.zip with attachment headers. Git tag studio-framework-v1.8.

when: opening an undeployed workers.dev zip URL or previewing a zip without attachment headers
fact: User said 保存できない。リンク先が見れない. Production workers.dev zip was not deployed. Local wrangler served the zip as an asset without Content-Disposition, so preview showed no destination.
insight: A zip URL is not a visible page. Save needs a landing page plus attachment headers on a running server.

when: publishing Studio Framework as a site zip instead of a GitHub framework
fact: User said 間違えた and asked to put the framework on GitHub as a framework.
insight: A Worker zip is the wrong store. The framework belongs in git, then GitHub.

when: keeping Studio Framework in git for GitHub instead of a public zip
fact: Removed public/studio-framework.html, the zip, and the Worker download routes.
decision: Source of truth is .cursor/framework and .cursor/rules. Tag studio-framework-v1.8 is the settled snapshot. Current HEAD is v1.10. Create the GitHub repository from this project.

when: registering Growth Map v1.0 to map and record how units grow
fact: User asked to map how the minimal units grow little by little, record that process in detail, and make a dedicated Feature.
insight: Field Ledger records events. Lineage needs its own map and log.
decision: Growth Map v1.0. Studio Framework v1.11. Feature Registry v1.8. Tree GROWTH.txt. Index growth/index.json. Process growth/log.jsonl.

when: asking whether each framework improvement is automatically reflected to GitHub
fact: Origin is Cursor git, not GitHub. Growth Map writes files. This agent commits and pushes those files to origin after improvements. No GitHub repository exists yet. Growth Map does not call GitHub.
insight: GitHub reflection starts after Create repo. Then the same push path can land on GitHub. It is git push, not a Growth Map webhook.

when: recommending GitHub name studio-framework and an Entheria description
fact: User said studio is too specific and Entheria Studio does not belong in the name or description.

fact: The portable kernel is Unit Kernel. Purpose Pack is what names a studio.
